title: feat: Ability to delete a contact
body:
**Is your enhancement request related to a problem? Please describe.**
During testing we have created multiple contacts with random e-mail Id's, But now we are unable to delete any of the contact. There is no API to delete a contact or on the web page also we don't see an option to delete a contact.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
It would be better if we can delete contact on webpage as well an API to delete a contact, there is already an API to create and edit contact so delete would also add more value to it.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
If we were using self hosted option I guess we could delete on database directly but I didn't find any alternative way to delete a contact since we are using chatwoot on basic plan.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
It may also be better for GDPR/CCPA/etc that for contacts which have no conversations associated or any other data for them to be automatically deleted.

This means only data which is kept matching actual content (chat/message) data is kept.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: ## Acceptance ## Backend - API to delete contact conferring to the following standards ``` DELETE api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/contacts/{id} # returns head: ok if successful # accessible only to administrators # agent tokens should return unauthorized ``` - triggering API should clear the following information ``` - Contact - Conversations - Contact Inboxes - Associated Reporting Events ``` - Swagger documentation for the delete API - Test and document the following implications hold when the same contact sends another message - Website inbox: The current chat stops working if the user refreshes the page, a new contact gets generated, and they can continue the conversation on the widget - Conversation continuity: fails because conversation doesn't exist - Facebook: New contact / New conversation created - Twitter: New contact / New conversations created - SMS: New contact / New conversations created - Whatsapp: New contact / New conversations created - Email channel: New contact / New conversation created - API Channel: Further requests fail, need to create a new contact - Webhook & Websocket events for contact deleted ## Frontend - Admins should be able to see the delete option in contact pannel in conversations view - Clicking on delete triggers a model and on confirm should delete the contact, all associated information - Data associated to the contact should be cleared from the store if the contact delete event is received in websocket ``` - Contact - Conversations ``` ## Testing - Deleting the contact should clear the contact and all associated conversations - Deleting the contact should confirm the above behaviors documented for each channel - Only Admin users should be able to delete a contact - Agents shouldn't be able to see the delete contact option - Agents shouldn't be able to hit delete contact endpoint - Reports should reflect correct data concerning the conversations that were deleted because of contact delete ## Note Frontend and Backend Pieces of this story could be worked separately in sequence - Add a warning to the agent if the user is online.

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body: The merge contact -> https://github.com/chatwoot/chatwoot/pull/2457 has context menu next to contact info which is a good place to keep the `delete contact` option.
